entry_points.text: Module setup scans headers for bug table, records base/count and links list; teardown unlinks. Boot init publishes read-only closures debugfs and succeeds.

Blocking sync attaches stack waiter and callback, sleeps until flagged, restores running. Timed expiry restores count by CAS only when pending/not running else timeout. Return variant installs callback, releases running, sleeps while refs remain, releases parent.

exports.text: Bootconfig init with diagnostics, sorted search, unsigned byte compare, I/O signature match, 32/64-bit zero counts, double-word ordering, mask alloc/free and stack dump.
Btree lifecycle uses dedicated slab cache at load/unload, clears mempool nodes, starts empty with no root, attaches caller or owned mempool with failure report, releases root and mempool on destroy.

Btree query descends by first slot not greater, scans leaf for equality, updates or signals absence, follows first children for smallest, retries decremented keys for predecessor, merges by draining smallest, visits in order with width adapters.

Bucket alloc derives size from processor count with caps, publishes mask size-minus-one and frees array. Bug surface resolves core then module tables, decodes file/line and format, classifies traps and resets single-fire markers.
Build-ID offers file/memory reader init with cleanup, faulting and non-faulting mapping parsers, explicit file and raw buffer parsers, plus boot init from linked note extent into read-only storage.

Cache coherency offers sized alloc, register/unregister with release, range invalidate and presence test. Checksums cover headers, partial/full buffers and pseudo-headers. Closures offer ref release, waitlist wake/enroll and list reversal.

CPU rmap offers create, ref handling, object insert and affinity remap plus IRQ glue attach/detach/notify/release. Codetag offers section need/alloc/free, replace notify, load/unload and type registration.
ID/radix surface offers base-adjusted removal, iterator tag clear, root tagged test and bounded free-slot search with iterator publication.

hazards.text: Tree assumes non-null unique keys, valid levels and occupancy; violations fatal; callers serialize, no internal locking. Bootconfig single-shot until exit; second init busy; failures release all and report position/diagnostics.

Fetch pointers invalidate after later fetches, copy before next; null/sticky error on fail; missing/not-uptodate folios fail without faulting; mappings released once; word loads assume alignment support.

Guard/zero-ref/magic violations warn or fatal; timeout CAS must loop. Byte CAS rewrites whole word, siblings retry with word granularity. Shrink never collapses IDR zero and poisons child with retry for lockless restart.

Free search encodes nospace/nomem including start-over-max and growth failure; preload only when non-blocking outside IRQ else direct. Load callback runs under exclusivity; unload drains RCU before mutate; affinity tmp-mask failure only logged.

invariants.text: Nodes pack keys low with values/links after; helpers order lexicographically, copy/clear spans, assign slots and decrement with borrow. Position finds first slot not greater, fill finds first empty, mutation widens rightmost coverage.

Single-fire warnings emit at most once until global reset; completed and suppressed tests classify as warning without output. Format/cut omitted only when flagged; warnings account with location/taint else critical or none.

Readers require spans within extent, reject oversize/wrap/secret, allow sleep only when flagged else need cached up-to-date folios with direct or staged return. ELF needs known magic/type/class and capped headers; notes need room, aligned extents, type/name match, then copy/pad.

Checksum core compensates odd start/tail endian, aligns to words, accumulates with carry, folds and swaps when odd. Cache applies primary to every instance then completion, stopping on first error; completion optional.

Signed conversion negates unsigned tail; narrow forms forward to widest bounded parser. Zero base selects 16/8/10 with prefix skip. Options signal missing/comma/range/final, ranges expand, memparse shifts K steps with saturate, token search and quoted arg split defined.

Byte CAS emulates via aligned word loop with reread/compare/install. Seq_buf appends only on fit else overflow with zero-size warn. Codetag text shows file:line plus module/function; span count is byte distance over tag size.

Registration resolves section bounds with preemption disabled, rejects missing/empty/inverted, assigns sequence and ID under exclusivity, runs load callback with rollback and charges count on success. IDR alloc validates bounds, finds free slot, publishes with tags. Replace adjusts counts, prunes ancestors, reclaims async.

Lookup loads root optimistically, rejects over-max, descends recording parent/slot, restarts on retry, stops at bottom. IDR find/scan adjust by base, skip empties/markers. Root tags are shifted bits; set/clear walk while changed; tag read prefers node else root; offset zero without parent.
Release frees container, insert scans first empty else nospace. Occupancy delta uses free mark for IDR else presence diff.
Deletion sets free marker for IDR else clears tags, replaces with null decrementing counts; null-node iterator tags are single bit else shifted window with clipping.

locks.text: Trap classifiers pair RCU entry/exit around classification; global once-reset iterates module tables under scoped RCU; list changes use RCU so fault lookups avoid blocking.

Instance list uses read-write semaphore: register/remove write, invalidate/presence read. Debug list uses IRQ-saving spinlock; create forbids double alive then links, destroy requires alive before dead/unlink except stack.

Diagnostic holds closure spinlock IRQ-saving across traversal. Module readers take shared blocking/try ownership with matching unlock, registration takes exclusivity; content/count readers must already hold semaphore.

state_machines.text: Storage moves empty/populated/released. Exit releases areas, clears size/count/brace and honors early release; failed init unwinds via exit after diagnostics; reentry refused.
Insertion grows height when level exceeds depth, splits full nodes at midpoint into sibling linked via parent, shifts to open gap, then stores pair; null values and duplicates forbidden.

Removal deletes slot, shifts successors, then rebalances below top, shrinks single-child root or clears drained tree. Rebalance merges underfilled neighbor when combined fits; merging empty child removes parent link and frees node.

Zero refs observe barrier, clear rearm; with callback and no destructor reinit and requeue, else teardown and release parent. Oops counter inc/dec with console wake at zero. Tag iteration walks IDs in order, restarts on sequence change, steps by size, memoizes.

Free search loads root, skips occupied prefix, enforces bound, extends height, descends creating marked nodes, scans for marked bits, ascends/restarts on overflow, publishes bounds. Extension inserts levels propagating marks until coverage.
Affinity remap invalidates entries pointing at target, seeds new set at zero distance with node expansion, then inherits neighbors across sibling/core/node scopes in topology order.

structs.text: Geometry carries key words plus pair/key capacities; three globals cover narrow/word/wide. Node extent is max(cacheline,128); words-per-u64 and max span bound buffers.

Codetag type links globally, counts live tags, indexes modules by ID with semaphore, carries descriptor with size/callbacks and sequence counters. Range pairs start/stop, module pairs owner/range/sequence. IRQ glue pairs notifier/back-pointer/index.

ABI facts: 256-entry table runs 0..8 doubling to long eights; note type 3, header cap 256, staging 64; section prefix .codetag.; nodes use low tag bit with compose/strip; max index is map size scaled by shift minus one.
Fresh nodes record shift, offset, occupancy/value counts, parent and root. Sync waiter pairs current task with completion flag.
